```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400" width="400" height="400">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="blue" cx="45%" cy="35%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3a7bff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0b3fbf"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="peach" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe2c0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f2b98a"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="iris" cx="40%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6fe36f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1c8a2c"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Back quills -->
  <path d="M190 110
           L40 70  L150 150
           L20 175 L150 200
           L35 285 L165 250
           L90 345 L210 290 Z"
        fill="url(#blue)" stroke="#0a2a80" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <path d="M165 125 L150 45 L215 105 Z" fill="url(#blue)" stroke="#0a2a80" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M168 115 L158 70 L196 104 Z" fill="#f2b98a"/>
  <path d="M245 110 L285 40 L290 125 Z" fill="url(#blue)" stroke="#0a2a80" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M253 108 L280 65 L282 115 Z" fill="#f2b98a"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="225" cy="200" r="100" fill="url(#blue)" stroke="#0a2a80" stroke-width="5"/>

  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <path d="M175 235
           Q170 180 230 205
           Q300 175 320 225
           Q315 295 245 300
           Q180 300 175 235 Z"
        fill="url(#peach)" stroke="#0a2a80" stroke-width="4"/>

  <!-- Eyes (joined white) -->
  <path d="M200 205
           Q180 140 225 130
           Q245 128 250 150
           Q262 125 290 135
           Q320 155 300 210
           Q275 225 250 200
           Q225 228 200 205 Z"
        fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0a2a80" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Irises -->
  <ellipse cx="232" cy="175" rx="14" ry="24" fill="url(#iris)"/>
  <ellipse cx="282" cy="175" rx="13" ry="23" fill="url(#iris)"/>

  <!-- Pupils -->
  <ellipse cx="235" cy="177" rx="7" ry="13" fill="#111"/>
  <ellipse cx="285" cy="177" rx="7" ry="12" fill="#111"/>

  <!-- Highlights -->
  <circle cx="231" cy="168" r="4" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="281" cy="168" r="4" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="222" rx="16" ry="11" fill="#111"/>
  <ellipse cx="295" cy="218" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#fff" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Smirk -->
  <path d="M215 262 Q255 290 300 255" fill="none" stroke="#0a2a80" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M296 250 L305 262" stroke="#0a2a80" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
```
